Does per(A) ~= W(S,M,eta) admit a bounded t-structure? As a distinct conditional, is Stab(per(A)) empty?
decisive_failure: originality: Terminal paid search returned a decisive prior covering the stability half of the headline: the EMS Oberwolfach record states Stab(per(A))=empty for exactly the Corollary 3 algebras with relations {ab,bc} and |a|+|b|=|b|+|c|=1, citing Haiden-Wu arXiv:2502.12075. Fetched Haiden-Wu body proves Theorem 4.5/Corollary 1.3 that the standard-grading one-boundary one-stop genus-1 Fukaya category admits no stability condition. This substantively implies the submitted nonempty-stability claim is not original (and on the cited evidence, false as stated).
